item.title: My coding agent kept re-reading the internet

item.description: Why this blog exists, what I plan to write about, and why it lives on its own subdomain.

item.title: My API never sends emails (and yours shouldn’t either)
item.description: What I learned building TaskForge: move slow work out of the request path with Postgres, Redis and a pool of workers.

item.title: My job queue said completed. It was lying.
